description: Source code for interrupt service routines (ISRs) in the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform, including ISR initialization, addition, handling, and context management.

methods.name: Os_IsrInit
methods.description: Initializes the ISR system, sets up vector-to-ISR mapping, and attaches ISRs.

methods.name: Os_IsrAdd
methods.description: Adds a new ISR to the system, assigns an ID, and enables its vector.

methods.name: Os_IsrGetApplicationOwner
methods.description: Returns the application owner of a given ISR.

methods.name: Os_Isr_cr4
methods.description: Handles ISR for ARM CR4 architecture, setting active vector and calling Os_Isr.

methods.name: Os_Isr
methods.description: Main ISR handler that manages context saving, dispatching, and scheduling after an interrupt.

methods.name: Os_IsrGetStackInfo
methods.description: Provides stack information for ISR handling.

methods.name: Os_Arc_GetIsrInfo
methods.description: Copies ISR info into an ARC PCB structure.

methods.name: Os_Arc_GetIsrCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of ISRs.
